title: Narrow two-card-types class is reconstructible
statement_en: Every graph G on at least 3 vertices whose degrees are all d or d + 1, whose cards at vertices of equal degree are isomorphic, and which has a card isomorphism α : G − u ≅ G − u' and a neighbour x of u with α(x) not adjacent to u' (so α does not extend to an automorphism), is reconstructible (narrow two-card-types class, Zinchenko arXiv:2611.13728 §§2–4; debe_zinchenko.md §6 N).
statement_lean: Recon.ClassReconstructible (fun n G => (∃ d : ℕ, ∀ x : Fin n, (G.neighborSet x).ncard = d ∨ (G.neighborSet x).ncard = d + 1) ∧ (∀ x y : Fin n, (G.neighborSet x).ncard = (G.neighborSet y).ncard → Nonempty (G.induce ({x}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce ({y}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)))) ∧ ∃ u u' : Fin n, ∃ α : G.induce ({u}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce ({u'}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), ∃ x : ({u}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), G.Adj u x.1 ∧ ¬ G.Adj u' (α x).1)
author: round10
